stories.title: Brasileira mata filha de 4 anos e atira contra si mesma após perder guarda da criança nos EUA

en.title: Brazilian woman kills 4-year-old daughter and shoots herself after losing child custody in the USA
en.summary: A Brazilian woman fatally shot her 4-year-old daughter and then shot herself following the loss of custody of the child in the United States.

stories.title: Criança fica gravemente ferida e é socorrida de helicóptero após cair de motocicleta com 4 ocupantes da mesma família no ES

en.title: Child seriously injured and rescued by helicopter after falling from motorcycle with 4 family members in ES
en.summary: A 4-year-old girl was seriously injured when a motorcycle carrying her parents and 6-month-old sister went off the road and hit a road sign in Espírito Santo. The child required intubation and helicopter rescue.

stories.title: Acompanhe a cobertura do 1º turno das eleições no Distrito Federal

en.title: Follow coverage of the first round of elections in the Federal District
en.summary: Voting takes place on Sunday across Brazil for federal deputies, district deputies, senators, governors, and president of the Republic.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: veja as propostas dos candidatos ao governo de São Paulo

en.title: 2026 Elections: see the proposals of candidates for the government of São Paulo
en.summary: The article presents the campaign proposals put forward by candidates running for governor of São Paulo in the 2026 elections.

stories.title: Eleições 2026 no Amazonas: veja o que candidatos podem e não podem fazer no dia da votação

en.title: 2026 Elections in Amazonas: see what candidates can and cannot do on voting day
en.summary: Brazilian electoral authorities have outlined rules for candidates and parties on the first round of voting scheduled for Sunday. Campaign activities including canvassing, distributing campaign materials, holding rallies, and using sound amplification equipment are prohibited on election day.

stories.title: Alcolumbre leva PEC do fim da escala 6x1 ao plenário do Senado na terça-feira

en.title: Alcolumbre brings PEC ending 6x1 work shift to Senate floor on Tuesday
en.summary: Brazil's Senate president has scheduled debate on a constitutional amendment to eliminate the 6x1 work schedule for the Tuesday following the first round of elections on Sunday.

stories.title: Acompanhe a cobertura do 1º turno das eleições em Pernambuco

en.title: Follow coverage of the 1st round of elections in Pernambuco
en.summary: The first round of Brazil's 2026 elections takes place on Sunday, with over 7.2 million eligible voters in Pernambuco participating.

stories.title: Estadão fará cobertura especial em vídeo no 1º turno das eleições 2026; veja como assistir

en.title: Estadão will provide special video coverage on 1st round of 2026 elections; see how to watch
en.summary: A Brazilian news outlet is offering special video coverage of the first round of voting in the 2026 elections.

stories.title: Candidatos a deputado federal em 2026: veja lista atualizada em todo Brasil

en.title: Federal deputy candidates in 2026: see updated list across Brazil
en.summary: Brazilians will vote on Sunday the 4th to elect federal deputies for the Chamber of Deputies with terms beginning in 2027. Candidate lists for all states and the Federal District are available for the 2026 elections.

stories.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual em 2026: veja lista atualizada de todo o Brasil

en.title: State deputy candidates in 2026: see updated list from all Brazil
en.summary: Brazilians will vote on Sunday the 4th to elect state deputies for legislative assemblies with terms beginning in 2027. Candidate lists for all states and the Federal District are available for the 2026 elections.

stories.title: Alcolumbre marca votação da PEC da escala 6x1 para terça-feira (6)

en.title: Alcolumbre schedules vote on 6x1 work schedule PEC for Tuesday (6)
en.summary: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre scheduled the constitutional amendment proposal eliminating the 6x1 work schedule for voting on Tuesday the 6th, during the first deliberative session after Sunday's election.

stories.title: Candidatos ao Senado no Paraná em 2026: veja lista atualizada

en.title: Senate candidates in Paraná in 2026: see updated list
en.summary: Paraná has registered Senate candidacies for 2026 with names and registration status at the Electoral Justice. Data were extracted from the Superior Electoral Court disclosure portal on October 1, 2026.

stories.title: Nuklio Viagens: IA transforma fotos e áudios em fotolivro

en.title: Nuklio Viagens: AI transforms photos and audio into photo book
en.summary: Nuklio Viagens uses artificial intelligence to automatically create travel photo books in about five minutes from customer photos and audio recordings. The system selects images, organizes sequences, designs layouts, and writes text without requiring a designer or editor.

stories.title: Datafolha: Em SP, Flávio Bolsonaro registra 39% das intenções de voto ante 38% de Lula

en.title: Datafolha: In SP, Flávio Bolsonaro registers 39% of voting intentions against 38% for Lula
en.summary: A Datafolha survey shows presidential candidates Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a technical tie among São Paulo voters, with Bolsonaro at 39% and Lula at 38%, a five-point increase for Lula compared to the previous week.

stories.title: Madart Festival reúne gastronomia e lazer na Vila Madalena

en.title: Madart Festival brings gastronomy and leisure to Vila Madalena
en.summary: The Madart Festival will take place on October 3rd in Vila Madalena, featuring food, music, and entertainment with free admission. The event aims to highlight a new real estate development by construction companies MPD Engenharia and STAN Desenvolvimento Imobiliário.

stories.title: Alcolumbre pauta discussão do fim da escala 6x1 no plenário para a próxima semana

en.title: Alcolumbre schedules discussion of ending 6x1 work shift in plenary for next week
en.summary: Senate president Davi Alcolumbre scheduled discussion of a constitutional amendment to eliminate the 6x1 work shift for next week in the plenary. Without accelerated procedural approval, the vote may be postponed until after the second round of elections.

stories.title: ANP aprova delimitação de novas áreas de petróleo na Margem Equatorial

en.title: ANP approves delineation of new oil areas in Equatorial Margin
en.summary: Brazil's oil regulator approved 501 new petroleum blocks across five basins in the Equatorial Margin, covering approximately 380,000 square kilometers. The blocks were delineated following an extension of Brazil's Continental Shelf.
